Small ENCODE region sets used by the examples of the agent skills (inst/skills/).
Both are subsets (chr1 and chr2 only, first three columns, sorted, duplicates removed) of
released ENCODE files on GRCh38; data-raw/encode_example_regions.R makes them.

LNCaP_R1881_DNase_ENCFF570MWX_chr1-2.bed.gz  (19,077 regions)
  DNase-seq peaks of LNCaP clone FGC treated with 1 nM R1881 (17beta-hydroxy-17-methylestra-
  4,9,11-trien-3-one) for 12 h. ENCODE experiment ENCSR000EKU (Gregory Crawford lab, Duke),
  file ENCFF570MWX (bed narrowPeak, "peaks", ENCODE4 pipeline v3.0.0, GRCh38),
  md5 of the downloaded file 11fc2eb70efc494a00217350f0e83035.
  Used as the background (universe) of the overlap test in the range-tf example, whose AR
  ChIP-seq peaks come from LNCaP-ARmo cells at 1 nM DHT (GSE48308), and as the range-atac example.

prostate_H3K27me3_ENCFF198QRW_chr1-2.bed.gz  (2,385 regions)
  H3K27me3 ChIP-seq "replicated peaks" of adult prostate gland tissue (male, 37 years).
  ENCODE experiment ENCSR690CSD (Bradley Bernstein lab, Broad), file ENCFF198QRW
  (bed narrowPeak, ENCODE4 histone pipeline v1.5.1, GRCh38),
  md5 of the downloaded file db7ed4b10bdf4f8eb4a7e37d14e50ea0.
  Used as the range-histone example.

Licence and citation. ENCODE data use policy (https://www.encodeproject.org/help/citing-encode/,
read 2026-11-09): "External data users may freely download, analyze and publish results based on
any ENCODE data without restrictions." Please cite the ENCODE Project Consortium (Nature 2012,
489:57-74; Nature 2020, 583:699-710), the portal (Luo et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2020, 48:D882-D889)
and the experiment accessions above.
